title: HTML Foundations
description: Learn the building blocks of the web: HTML elements, attributes, semantic markup, and document structure.

title: CSS Styling & Layout
description: Master CSS selectors, flexbox, grid, responsive design, and modern CSS features like custom properties and container queries.

title: JavaScript Essentials
description: Variables, functions, control flow, DOM manipulation, events, and asynchronous programming with promises and async/await.

title: Generics & Type Parameters
description: Understanding generic types, constraints, default type parameters, and generic utility types.

title: Conditional & Mapped Types
description: Advanced type-level programming with conditional types, infer keyword, mapped types, and template literal types.

title: Relational Database Design
description: Entity-relationship modeling, normalization forms (1NF through BCNF), and schema design best practices.

title: Advanced PostgreSQL
description: CTEs, window functions, JSONB operations, full-text search, and performance tuning with EXPLAIN ANALYZE.

title: React Hooks Deep Dive
description: useState, useEffect, useContext, useReducer, useMemo, useCallback, and custom hooks patterns.

title: State Management Patterns
description: Context API, Zustand, and server state management with TanStack Query. When to use each approach.

title: Testing React Applications
description: Unit testing with Vitest, component testing with Testing Library, and E2E testing with Playwright.
